caption:
Holiday shopping forecast is in. 🎁

The National Retail Federation expects November and December retail sales to grow 4.2% from last year, to about $1.013 trillion.

That's a lot of gift receipts. Prices are up too, so a bigger total doesn't always mean more stuff.

Are you spending more, the same, or less this holiday season?
first_comment: Be honest: what's your holiday budget this year? 👇
